concept: Review and integration: a lifelong relationship with quality, mastery, and passing on what you know
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative review, not sourced from any external text

exercise.reflection_prompt: Across maintaining standards under pressure, continued mastery, and mentoring others — what's your personal throughline as a craftsperson?
exercise.practice: Adult writes a short personal statement on what craftsmanship means to them in practice

assessment.success_marker: adult produces a personal statement referencing at least two of the three adult-stage scenarios
